newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 46.488 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 46.488 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Thursday sold two discount T-bill issues with maturities of one week and four weeks, yielding 3.80 percent and 17.62 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 53.072 billion levs of T-bills but the ministry approved bids for 46.488 billion levs worth of paper.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Auction date and maturity date for each issue overlap.
Details of the issues follow. Prices are in percent of par: Issue number BG3023497004 BG3023597001
Bids received 32,362.3 million levs 20,709.5 million levs
Avg price of bids 96.34 pct 85.02 pct
Bids approved 26,198.3 million levs 20,289.5 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.80 pct 17.62 pct
